quote: No person shall engage in any motor vehicle speed contest or exhibition of power or speed on a highway and no person shall aid or abet in any such motor vehicle speed contest or exhibition upon any highway.

activation.condition: A person and another motorist on a highway.

obligation.description: No person shall aid or abet a motor vehicle speed contest upon a highway.

timing.description: Original cue relative to another motorist start and full episode.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Other motorist motion and coordinated timing do not themselves define a legal contest.
A physical start cue and temporal ordering do not themselves decide legal assistance or intent.
